commodityNotFound: We do not track mandi prices for that crop yet.
emptySeries: No price reports in this window.
guidanceFalling: Prices are down {{pct}}% this week. If your produce is perishable, selling sooner may protect its value.
guidanceRising: Prices are up {{pct}}% this week in {{district}}. If you can store safely, waiting may pay — decide with your buyer.
guidanceStable: Prices are steady at around ₹{{modal}} per quintal.
guidanceUnavailable: There are not enough recent price reports to describe a trend yet.
momentumNote: This is a recent change within a different month-long trend.
myCropsEmpty: Add an active crop to see mandi prices for it.
nearbyEmpty: No recent mandi prices were found near your farm.
neverPredicts: We describe what prices have already done. We never predict what they will do.
noDistanceNote: Mandi locations are not published, so these are grouped by district.
noSignal: Not enough recent reports to describe a trend.
priceAdjusted: The reported modal price fell outside the day's min–max range and was adjusted to the nearest bound.
sourceHistorical: Historical prices — not today's mandi rates.
